errors.evidence: The symbol in the y-axis label is described as a downward arrow ($\downarrow$), but the figure shows a leftward arrow (<-).

The description states that the x-axis values range from 0.2 to 1.0. This describes the labeled ticks, but the actual data starts at x=0.1, which is outside this range. The description later correctly identifies the first data point at x=0.1, creating a contradiction.

The description states that the y-axis values range from 22 to 28. This describes the labeled ticks, but the actual data values extend beyond this range, starting as high as approximately 29.3 and ending as low as approximately 21.3.

The description of the "TrajICL" line omits the data points at x=0.5 (y~22.1) and x=0.8 (y~21.4), instead incorrectly summarizing the trend from x=0.3 as a steady decline. The prompt requires noting changes using exact data points.

The description of the "Full FT" line omits the data point at x=0.8 (y~26.6), instead incorrectly summarizing the trend from x=0.5 as a steady decline. The prompt requires noting changes using exact data points.

The description states that the y-axis tick labels range from 22 to 28, but fails to mention that the data range extends beyond this, with the 'Full FT' line reaching a maximum value of approximately 29.3. Similarly, it states the x-axis tick labels range from 0.2 to 1.0, omitting that the data actually starts at x=0.1. This provides an incomplete description of the value range ('Wertebereich') requested in the prompt.
